## 환경변수 설정
.env.example 파일 이름 .env 로 변경
api key 추가
 - OPENAI_API_KEY
 - LANGSMITH_API_KEY
 - TAVILY_API_KEY

## dependency 설치
~~~
uv sync
~~~

## postgres 컨테이너 시작 테이블 생성
~~~
docker-compose up -d
~~~

~~~
-- auto-generated definition
create table transaction
(
    id           bigserial
        primary key,
    type         varchar(10) not null,
    name         varchar(50) not null,
    amount       bigint      not null
        constraint transaction_amount_check
            check (amount > 0),
    user_id      varchar(20) not null,
    created_time timestamp   not null
);

comment on table transaction is '가계부 거래 내역을 저장하는 테이블';

comment on column transaction.id is '거래 고유 ID';

comment on column transaction.type is '거래 타입 (수입, 지출)';

comment on column transaction.name is '거래 항목';

comment on column transaction.amount is '거래 금액';

comment on column transaction.user_id is '사용자 ID';

comment on column transaction.created_time is '거래 생성 시간';

alter table transaction
    owner to admin;

create index idx_transaction_user_id
    on transaction (user_id);

~~~
